scope: Festival planet, shared static batching and shared anime renderer
method: 180 requestAnimationFrame intervals per view after 45 warm-up frames. Single active WebGL tab, same viewport and detailed quality. Shadow render counts depend on the sampled frame. Baseline and optimized scenes ran at different animation times, so this is a frame-pacing smoke check, not a deterministic GPU benchmark.
interpretation: Both versions were already near the 60 Hz ceiling on this computer; no measured overall FPS increase is claimed. Geometry and simulated upload reductions are separately quantified.
